*   `?g A4`: Main concept is Fauna/Animal.
    *   `+ Black`: Associated with black.
    *   `+ White`: Associated with white.
    *   `+ E1`: Associated with Cold/Snow/Rain/Cloud.

    *   An animal that is black and white and associated with cold/snow.

    *   Penguin (Black and white, lives in cold environments).
    *   Polar Bear (White, but not black/white usually, though maybe some part?). Wait, Polar bear is white.
    *   Panda (Black and white, but not specifically "cold/snow" in the same iconic way as a penguin, though they live in mountains).
    *   Snow Leopard (White/grey).
    *   Orca (Black and white, but lives in water/ocean, though they live in cold regions).
    *   Skunk (Black and white, not cold).

    *   Penguin is the strongest candidate for "Black, White, Cold".

    *   Guess 1: Penguin
    *   Guess 2: Panda
    *   Guess 3: Orca
